readme.markdown:
# BotFactory MCP Farm

Hosted MCP servers on [MCPize](https://mcpize.com) — zero-auth public APIs, freemium x402 (USDC on Base).

## Catalog

See [CATALOG.md](./CATALOG.md) for the full list with gateway URLs.

## Connect

```
https://<slug>.mcpize.run/mcp
```

Requires an x402-capable MCP client for paid tools. `health_check` and discovery tools are free.

## Awesome list entries

See [AWESOME_ENTRIES.md](./AWESOME_ENTRIES.md).

toolsPreview.name: analyze_seo_keywords
toolsPreview.description:
Extract top SEO keywords from marketing copy using term frequency.
    Returns: {keywords: [{word, score}], total_words}

toolsPreview.name: extract_meta_tags
toolsPreview.description:
Fetch a page and extract HTML meta tags (title, description, og:*).
    Returns: {title, description, og_title, og_description, meta: {name: content}}

toolsPreview.name: word_frequency
toolsPreview.description:
Count word frequencies in text for content/marketing analysis.
    Returns: {words: [{word, count, pct}], total}
